features.name: Mess Mate (Menu Voting & Prep Sheets)
features.description: Currently MessManagerView.tsx directly loads getMockVote() and getMockPrepSheet() on initialization, bypasses database interactions, and uses unmatched backend endpoint paths.
features.why: Menu voting and kitchen headcounts were designed as a frontend-only demo without database persistence validation.

features.name: Beckn ONDC Mobility Grid Integration
features.description: Ride searching and option calculation in becknAdapter.ts are fully simulated client-side using coordinate distance formulas, bypass the backend, and lacks actual network registry queries.
features.why: ONDC/Beckn protocols require active gateway infrastructure and sandboxed BPP registries.

features.name: AR Mandi Crop Quality Grading
features.description: ARMandiHUD.tsx generates static crop quality results and recommended pricing, rather than sending captured image payloads to the ML grading server.
features.why: Requires camera canvas frame extraction, binary image uploads, and running computer vision models on backend.

features.name: Gemini Voice Co-Pilot Speech Booking
features.description: Fallback voice recording simulation using a hardcoded Bhojpuri/Hindi sentence if microphone API or audio upload is blocked.
features.why: Audio recording blobs require format transcoding and integration with cloud Speech-to-Text APIs.

features.name: Ultrasonic QR Soundbox Verification
features.description: Sound transmission is simulated using regular browser AudioContext beeps, and the token verification is not secured against the database.
features.why: Raw PCM audio processing and high-frequency ultrasonic filtering can be unstable across devices.

features.name: Tesla-like Autopilot 3D Proximity Radar
features.description: ProximityRadar3D.tsx uses mock vehicles array in ref to simulate traffic movement, rather than active websockets geolocation feeds of nearby drivers.
features.why: For demonstration when testing in isolation or without other live drivers nearby.

features.name: Alternative Credit Scoring & PM SVANidhi Offers
features.description: creditScoreService.ts returns a hardcoded 720 score and preset factors if the backend calculation fails.
features.why: Requires real aggregated transaction logs and orders history for the active vendor.

features.name: Universal QR Scanner Trigger Simulators
features.description: UniversalQRScanner.tsx renders direct click triggers simulating successful scans of products, shops, and payments to bypass camera scanning.
features.why: Allows testing core scanner workflows in desktop environments.
